   495→      removeFromQueue(currentOutfitIdRef.current)

   501→        setIsFromCache(true)
   502→        hasAttemptedRef.current = true
   503→      } else {

   505→        setIsFromCache(false)
   506→        hasAttemptedRef.current = false
   507→      }
   508→
   509→      setIsGenerating(false)
   510→      setIsQueued(false)
   511→      setQueuePosition(0)

   515→  }, [outfitId])

   522→      const pos = getQueuePosition(outfitId)

   537→    isMountedRef.current = true
   538→    return () => {
   539→      isMountedRef.current = false

   541→      removeFromQueue(outfitId)

   547→   */

   549→    if (!isMountedRef.current) return
   550→

   552→    setIsQueued(false)
   553→    setQueuePosition(0)
   554→    setIsGenerating(true)
   555→    setError(undefined)

   566→

   572→    // Log visual consistency warnings

   696→export function useIntersectionObserver(
   697→  callback: () => void,
   698→  options?: IntersectionObserverInit
   699→): React.RefCallback<HTMLElement> {
   700→  const observerRef = useRef<IntersectionObserver | null>(null)
   701→  const hasTriggeredRef = useRef(false)
   702→
   703→  const setRef = useCallback(
   704→    (element: HTMLElement | null) => {

   708→        observerRef.current = null
   709→      }
   710→
   711→      // Skip if already triggered or no element
   712→      if (hasTriggeredRef.current || !element) {
   713→        return

   716→      observerRef.current = new IntersectionObserver(
   717→        (entries) => {

   725→        },
   726→        {

   728→          ...options,
   729→        }
   730→      )
   731→
   732→      observerRef.current.observe(element)
   733→    },
   734→    [callback, options]
